internalCircuit.name: T Flip-Flop Demo
internalCircuit.description: 8-bit binary to packed BCD using unrolled double-dabble stages. IN1 is the MSB; OUT1..OUT4 hundreds, OUT5..OUT8 tens, OUT9..OUT12 ones.

metadata.outputOrder: OUT1..OUT4 hundreds BCD, OUT5..OUT8 tens BCD, OUT9..OUT12 ones BCD; each digit MSB..LSB
fixedNotes: Tied chip_1.IN1 and chip_4.IN1 to 0 instead of leaving them floating.
Tied OUT1 and OUT2 to 0 instead of leaving the top hundreds bits floating.

metadata.outputOrder: OUT1..OUT4 hundreds BCD, OUT5..OUT8 tens BCD, OUT9..OUT12 ones BCD; each digit MSB..LSB
fixedNotes: IN1 is the 128 bit; IN8 is the 1 bit.
OUT1..OUT4 are hundreds, OUT5..OUT8 are tens, OUT9..OUT12 are ones.
Tied the two missing internal zero inputs and two missing top hundreds outputs to GND.

internalCircuit.name: Dabble Add-3 Corrector
internalCircuit.description: 4-bit add-3 correction stage. IN1/OUT1 are MSB; IN4/OUT4 are LSB. Values 0-4 pass through; values 5-15 output input + 3 modulo 16.

fixedNotes: IN1/OUT1 are MSB; IN4/OUT4 are LSB.
Values 0-4 pass through; values 5-15 output input + 3 modulo 16.
The original minimized circuit behaved correctly for valid BCD inputs 0-9 but had arbitrary outputs for 10-15.

internalCircuit.name: 15 Segment Hex Driver Fixed
internalCircuit.description: Simple 7-segment hex driver plus decimal point passthrough. Full 15-segment diagonals are reserved for a later driver.

fixedNotes: Simplified to classic seven-segment outputs A-G plus DOT_2.
Two-letter 15-segment diagonal/crossbar outputs are intentionally omitted for now.
Import the full 15-segment export later when building the ASCII driver/display variant.
